cohort: The study included 157 women attending an ultrasound clinic for IUD localization: 49 with IUD misplacement/dislocation and 108 controls with IUDs in the normal position.
finding: The presence of submucosal/intracavitary uterine fibroids, sonographic features of adenomyosis, narrow (<30 mm) or wide (>32 mm) uterine cavity transverse diameter, short uterine cavity length (<30 mm), and copper-containing IUDs were associated with increased odds of IUD misplacement and dislocation.
